center.title: Template Center
center.subtitle: Apply a LaTeX scaffold into your manuscript folder. Overlaps are explained before anything is overwritten.
center.openProject: Open a project before applying a template.
center.needManuscript: Configure a manuscript folder in Workspace settings first.
center.remoteOnlyLocal: LaTeX templates apply on this computer only. Open the project locally to use Template Center or restore backups.

detail.applyHint: Applying writes template files into your manuscript folder. If files already exist or you changed a previous template, you will see which paths will be touched and a backup will be saved first.

switch.l1: Same document family — matching sections and the abstract/front matter will be preserved where possible. Preamble and packages come from the new template.
switch.l2: Related document types (paper ↔ thesis) — section merge will be attempted. Review the result after switching.
switch.l3: These template types cannot be merged automatically. Your existing template files will be fully replaced. A backup will be saved.
switch.reset: Reset to the template original? Your modifications will be lost. A backup will be saved.
switch.firstUse: This project already contains files that overlap with the template. Applying will overwrite them. A backup will be saved.
switch.willTouch: Files that will be overwritten or written:
switch.willRemove: Template files that will be removed:
switch.noFileList: No per-file list for this step — confirm to continue.
switch.backupNote: A copy of overlapping or previously applied template files is saved under .workbench/backups before changes are written.
